title: Synthetic filtered nearest-neighbor recall comparison
method: Synthetic five-query set has ten exact eligible neighbors per query,50 total reference positions. Configurations recover 35,45 and 48, giving 70%,90%,96% micro-averaged recall@10. Same corpus, filters and distance are assumed; no latency or vendor ranking is claimed.
alt: Synthetic filtered nearest-neighbor recall comparison. Configuration A: 70 percent recall at 10; Configuration B: 90 percent recall at 10; Configuration C: 96 percent recall at 10. Illustrative values.
